operation.description: create: a new document, refused if it exists. update: set the given fields of an existing document; the others stay. delete: remove an existing document (not its subcollections).

document.description: The document's path, such as users/alice or users/alice/orders/o-1.

fields.description: create and update: field names and values. Values are plain JSON (strings, numbers, true or false, null, lists, objects) or Firestore typed values such as {"timestampValue": "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"} or {"referenceValue": "users/alice"}. A person approves the exact write.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
